name: @aqua/plugin-public-funnel
description: Aqua portal public funnel — accepts managed-challenge-protected Health Check completions into pending-only storage with non-PII events. Anonymous requests create no User, CRM Lead, Person, Prospect, card or session. A server-only idempotent promotion command requires exact mailbox proof or an authenticated actor and records exact CRM lineage; no public promotion endpoint exists yet.
